what.text: This page follows refugees from Türkiye living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 26227 Turkish refugees in France, 17.6% of all refugees from Türkiye.
Germany hosts the most Turkish refugees, followed by France, Canada and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Turkey between the government and the PKK from 1990 to 2013 and from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Turkey from 2015 to 2017, and over the government of Turkey with TAK and Yurtta Sulh Konseyi in 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 12770 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
